==Proto-Semitic==

===Etymology===
{{etymon|sem-pro|:inh|afa-pro:*lib-}}
From {{inh|sem-pro|afa-pro|*lib-||heart}}. Cognate with {{cog|ber-pro|*uləβ}} and {{cog|egy|jb}}.<ref>{{R:egy:Loprieno|31}}</ref> Militarev and Kogan also reconstruct a variant {{m|sem-pro||*libab-}} as common Semitic, from Hebrew {{m|hbo|לֵבָב}}, Aramaic and Modern South Arabian (probably {{m|sem-pro||*libib-}}).<ref>{{R:sem-pro:SED|volume=I|id=27|entry=*libb-}}</ref>

===Noun===
{{sem-noun|m}}

# [[heart]]
